hint_type: Type a title and press Enter.
lib_hint: What is actually here, by manufacturer and system. Coverage next to it answers the opposite question: what is missing.
lib_empty: The library is empty or not indexed yet.
emu_needs_url: No automatically resolvable source for this emulator — set its URL in the streaming host .env.
emu_rb_confirm: Roll {n} back to the previous build?
emu_rb_title: Step back one build ({n} kept) — currently: {v}
fw_hint: BIOS and firmware live on the streaming host, not in Romseerr. Anything missing here shows up as a black screen in the stream, so it is listed per platform.
fw_notinstalled: file is present but not installed in the emulator — install it there once
fw_nolauncher: no launch service configured — firmware state unknown
stream_single: single seat — one session at a time
stream_not_in_lib: The title must be in the library to stream it.
stream_manual: desktop opened — start the title there
stream_hint: For platforms the browser cannot emulate (PS2, GameCube, Wii, Switch). The emulator runs on the host; the browser receives video and audio. Without a launch service Romseerr only opens the desktop.
stream_seat2_hint: Second seat — only needed when the streaming host runs with --profile seat2. Two people can then play at once; Romseerr hands out the first free seat.
outbound_hint: Webhook and catalogue URLs come from users. By default Romseerr refuses private, loopback and link-local targets — otherwise any logged-in user could point the server at internal addresses. If your notification target lives on the same network, allow it explicitly here.
play_no_romm: Cannot play — RomM is not connected.
play_no_core: This platform cannot be emulated in the browser.
play_not_in_lib: The title must be in the library to play it.
play_too_large: Too large for the browser (limit {mb} MB).
play_romset: arcade: only with a matching romset
cat_hint: Catalogue JSON sources, one URL per line. Deliberately not shipped — the operator supplies the sources. Format: {name, downloads:[{title,uris,uploadDate,fileSize}]}.
cat_none: no source configured — the filehoster path is inactive
cfg_warn_hint: One path is unusable — downloads taking it never even start.
fav_hint: Titles you want to get back to quickly. Unlike the wishlist, they never disappear on their own.
wl_hint_head: Wishlist — what you do not have yet
cov_method: sum owned ÷ sum known — not the average of the percentages, which would weigh a small system like a large one.
bl_hint: Substring, not a regular expression. An entry matches if it appears anywhere in the title — case is ignored, and characters like . or * stand for themselves. Only the title is checked, not the file name, release group or platform. The rule applies to search, discover and recommendations, and it refuses new requests. It does not stop a request already running, and it removes nothing already in the library. It applies to every user of this instance.
jd_hint: Three views of the same handover: Romseerr sees the first two, JDownloader the third. Empty = default.
var_region_order: Region order — the order is the preference
var_hint: Instance-wide fallback for users who set nothing themselves. Region changes content (language, difficulty, censorship, 50/60 Hz) — that is not a quality ladder, so candidates follow this order rather than being sorted.
cov_nosnap: no snapshot — catalogue not fetched yet
cov_nosource: no catalogue source for this platform
cov_basis: Based on a snapshot from {src} (max {max} titles per platform). Metadata sets disagree about what counts as a distinct title — the percentage is an orientation, not a measurement.
wl_imp_hint: Paste a list or pick a file (TXT/CSV) — one title per line, optionally title;platform. Nothing is written until you confirm the preview.
wl_imp_trunc: Only the first {n} lines are checked.
wl_imp_nocheck: No IGDB credentials — no catalogue check; entries are imported unverified.
about_no_build: Provenance unknown — this instance cannot say whether it matches the source.
wiz_welcome_txt: This wizard connects you to the stack services (SABnzbd, Prowlarr, IGDB, RomM) step by step. You can test or skip each step.
wiz_done_txt: Basic configuration is done. You can adjust everything later under Settings → Connections.
about_feat_txt: Search across Archive.org + Usenet, dedup, discover, requests with approval, users & permissions, quotas, notifications (Discord/Telegram/email/web push), issues, PWA, API.
about_stack_txt: Orchestrates Prowlarr, SABnzbd, JDownloader and RomM. Connections configurable under Settings.
exp_hint: Saves settings, users & permissions, requests and wishlists as JSON. Without a passphrase, secrets (passwords, API keys, webhook URLs) are LEFT OUT — with one they are attached encrypted. The same passphrase is needed on import.
imp_conf_merge: Merge this import? Existing values are overwritten, anything not mentioned stays.
imp_conf_replace: REPLACE? Users, requests and wishlists are fully replaced by the file.
tls_hint: Provide cert + key (PEM) — the app then also starts an HTTPS listener on the chosen port (restart required). For web push/PWA without a separate reverse proxy.
conn_hint: Empty fields fall back to the environment (.env). Secrets are masked — leave blank to keep the current value.
un_hint: Measures the chain search → category → queue → collect folder without downloading anything. The last line shows both views of the same folder — if they diverge, downloads finish but are never picked up.
un_grab: The indexer test fetches ONE file per indexer — that counts as a grab against their hourly limit.
lo_hint: What a failed import could not use stays on disk instead of being deleted — otherwise the download would be gone and the cause impossible to inspect. Clearing them is up to you; anything older than the retention window expires on its own.
reimp_hint: Reads the already downloaded files again — no new download.
del_confirm: Remove this request from the list?
del_withfiles:
The downloaded folder is still there. Delete the files as well?

OK = delete request and files
Cancel = remove the request only (files stay)
del_left: Request removed — the files stay behind (see maintenance)
retry_other_hint: The same source failed twice — the next attempt uses a different one.
stream_ambiguous: This title exists on several platforms — which one do you mean?
jd_probe_hint: Drops an inert job into the watch folder and waits to see whether JDownloader picks it up. Answers “is anyone listening” — not whether a download then actually starts. Takes up to 30 s and leaves a disabled entry in the link grabber.
stream_badtoken: The launch service rejects Romseerr: the token does not match. The host is up — the same value has to be set on BOTH sides (Settings → streaming host, and STREAM_AGENT_TOKEN on the host).
stream_encrypted: This image is encrypted — the emulator only plays decrypted dumps.
stream_cia: CIA files are installation packages and do not boot directly.
stream_cia_update: This is an update, not a game — it belongs to another title and does not boot even once installed.
stream_cia_dlc: This is downloadable content (DLC), not a game of its own.
stream_cia_broken: This CIA cannot be read — its title header is missing or damaged.
